{"code": "import numpy as np

# Compute conversion rates stratified by customer segment
segment_rates = df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute overall conversion rates per channel
email_rate = df[df['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
paid_search_rate = df[df['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()

# Compute the raw difference
difference_raw = email_rate - paid_search_rate

# Compute the adjusted difference using stratification (weighted average)
# First, get the overall segment proportions
segment_counts = df['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True)

# Compute weighted conversion rate per channel
email_weighted = (segment_rates.loc['email'] * segment_counts).sum()
paid_search_weighted = (segment_rates.loc['paid_search'] * segment_counts).sum()

# Adjusted difference
adjusted_difference = email_weighted - paid_search_weighted

# Print results
print(f'Raw conversion rate - email: {email_rate:.4f}')
print(f'Raw conversion rate - paid_search: {paid_search_rate:.4f}')
print(f'Raw difference (email - paid_search): {difference_raw:.4f}')
print(f'Adjusted difference (stratified by segment): {adjusted_difference:.4f}')

# Check if the adjustment changes the sign or magnitude substantially
print(f'\nIs the adjustment substantial? {abs(difference_raw - adjusted_difference) > 0.05}')"}
